item.title: From food to tech to travel: the best student deals and discounts
item.summary: You can save money at university, especially using schemes such as UNiDAYS, Student Beans or TOTUM ‘Watch your spending, use free perks’: an insider’s tips on student money With rents on the up and food costing more, maintenance loans are stretched thinner than ever. Knowing how, and where, to get a discount can make a real difference. A golden rule is to register with the big discount websites and apps – UNiDAYS, Student Beans and TOTUM – using your university email address as soon as you have one. Each has a slightly different roster of retailers, so it is worth signing up to all three. Continue reading...
